# HandleIsAlive

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Tells whether a handle is live and its object has not died.

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
bool HandleIsAlive(Handle h);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) to test. |

## Returns

true if `h` is a live handle whose QUERY_STATUS is not ERR_DEAD.
